Tool shed bookings

The big tools in the shed can be booked by any member for half a day at a time. Write your name and plot number in the book that hangs inside the shed door, next to the tool you want, and bring it back clean. The bookings for the week are read out at the gate on Saturday morning.

Marsh Lane Allotments, 4 Marsh Lane. Open from dawn to dusk.
